module: LX-8020S and LX-8040S Series Console Servers
description: The LX-8000S 20 and 40 port Dual AC and DC units with an optional internal modem add high-end NEBS console management to MRV's LX Series Console Servers. The Linux based system is tuned for optimal performance, security and reliability. The LX-8000S models are designed for telco and data center applications that demand high quality and reliability standards, dual power and NEBS Level-3 Certification.
